meta_description:
557 likes, 127 comments - russellbrunson on October 20, 2026: "We filmed this in 2022. And for four years I’ve been waiting for the right moment to release it.

Not because I wasn't proud of it. But because it was one of the most vulnerable interventions I’ve had.

When @TonyRobbins brought me up for an intervention, I had spent time preparing my question, but I had no idea Tony was about to take it.

This went so much deeper than I expected it to.

It touched my kids. It touched on my faith. It touched the beliefs I've carried with me for most of my life.

And more importantly, it hit some of the more uncomfortable questions we should all be asking - who I am, what I believe, and whether the things I've always held to be true are real.

I've spent years teaching people how to change their lives. How to break through limitations. How to become who they're meant to be.

But this came at me from a blind-spot, and it hit very differently.

There's a reason this footage sat unreleased for four years.

Some moments are harder to share than others, especially when they reveal parts of yourself you're still trying to understand.

Four years later, I'm finally ready to share it.

The full intervention with Tony Robbins is now on my YouTube channel.

Comment YOUTUBE and I'll send you the full video 👇

#TonyRobbins #RussellBrunson #Mindset #PersonalDevelopment #YouTube".
